name: Hacker News
description: Browse live Hacker News stories, discussions, users, and site activity through the official API.
author: Raynard
samplePrompts: Who wrote the highest-scoring Hacker News story right now, and what is their karma?
Which three stories among the current Hacker News top 10 have the most comments?
Show me the latest Show HN projects and summarize the most discussed one.

tools.name: hn_list_top_stories
tools.description: List top stories from the official Hacker News API — the current front-page ranking on Hacker News. Fetches the /v0/topstories.json id feed and then each story item. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Returns each story's id, title, score, author and comment count; drill into one with hn_get_item, read its discussion with hn_get_item_comments, or filter by keyword/type/time with hn_search_stories.

tools.name: hn_list_new_stories
tools.description: List newest stories from the official Hacker News API — the most recently submitted stories on Hacker News. Fetches the /v0/newstories.json id feed and then each story item. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Returns each story's id, title, score, author and comment count; drill into one with hn_get_item, read its discussion with hn_get_item_comments, or filter by keyword/type/time with hn_search_stories.

tools.name: hn_list_best_stories
tools.description: List best stories from the official Hacker News API — the highest-voted recent stories on Hacker News. Fetches the /v0/beststories.json id feed and then each story item. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Returns each story's id, title, score, author and comment count; drill into one with hn_get_item, read its discussion with hn_get_item_comments, or filter by keyword/type/time with hn_search_stories.

tools.name: hn_list_ask_stories
tools.description: List Ask HN stories from the official Hacker News API — the latest "Ask HN" question posts on Hacker News. Fetches the /v0/askstories.json id feed and then each story item. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Returns each story's id, title, score, author and comment count; drill into one with hn_get_item, read its discussion with hn_get_item_comments, or filter by keyword/type/time with hn_search_stories.

tools.name: hn_list_show_stories
tools.description: List Show HN stories from the official Hacker News API — the latest "Show HN" project posts on Hacker News. Fetches the /v0/showstories.json id feed and then each story item. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Returns each story's id, title, score, author and comment count; drill into one with hn_get_item, read its discussion with hn_get_item_comments, or filter by keyword/type/time with hn_search_stories.

tools.name: hn_list_job_stories
tools.description: List job postings from the official Hacker News API — the latest job postings on Hacker News (who is hiring). Fetches the /v0/jobstories.json id feed and then each story item. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Returns each story's id, title, score, author and comment count; drill into one with hn_get_item, read its discussion with hn_get_item_comments, or filter by keyword/type/time with hn_search_stories.

tools.name: hn_search_stories
tools.description: Search and filter Hacker News stories fetched from a live feed (top, new, best, ask, show or job). The official API has no server-side search, so this tool scans up to scanLimit recent feed items (default 100, max 500) and filters client-side by keyword (title, author, URL or text), item type (story/job/poll), and time period (period enum, or an explicit minTime/maxTime Unix-second window). Returns matching story ids, titles, scores and dates — use hn_get_item for full details on a match.

tools.name: hn_get_item
tools.description: Fetch one Hacker News item by its numeric id — works for stories, comments, jobs, polls and poll options. Returns the title or text, type, author, score, comment count, URL, parent link and posting time, plus a result card. Use ids from hn_list_* or hn_search_stories; follow up with hn_get_item_comments for the discussion or hn_get_user for the author.

tools.name: hn_get_item_comments
tools.description: Fetch the top-level comments of a Hacker News story, poll or comment by id. Returns each direct reply with its id, author and plain-text body (HTML stripped), plus a result card with a comments table. Optional limit (1-30, default 10). Use hn_get_item on a comment id to follow its own replies (kids).

tools.name: hn_get_user
tools.description: Fetch a Hacker News user profile by exact case-sensitive username. Returns karma, account creation date, the about text (HTML stripped) and total submission count, plus a result card. Use author names returned by hn_list_*, hn_search_stories or hn_get_item.

tools.name: hn_get_max_item
tools.description: Get the current largest Hacker News item id from /v0/maxitem.json — a cheap activity heartbeat for the whole site. Every new story, comment, job or poll increments it, so it doubles as a "how busy is HN right now" metric. Use hn_get_item on nearby ids to inspect the newest content, or hn_get_live_updates for what changed.

tools.name: hn_get_live_updates
tools.description: Get the Hacker News live updates feed from /v0/updates.json: the item ids and profile names that changed most recently. Returns both counts and the raw id lists, plus a result card. Drill into changed items with hn_get_item and changed profiles with hn_get_user.
